title: 首个有效获批后的客户完成联动
prompt:
Draw one standalone 1490 × 1056 static prototype using the supplied application references and common style. This is fictional DEMO evidence, not a live platform result. Design the application history after Casey Parker C005 receives a genuine first approval. Use Meadow Home LLC, meadow-home.example, and hello@meadow-home.example. This continues the normal APP-003 correction branch; APP-004 does not exist here.

The header shows Stripe APP-003 approved, application owner 李敏, and customer completed. A compact saved-result strip shows the two distinct transitions: application under review to approved, customer incomplete to completed. A readable history includes the mistaken interpretation at 10/17/2026 11:00 PT, the manual correction by 李敏 at 13:20, and new evidence E-301 at 15:00. The new email explicitly approves APP-003; do not reuse document-receipt wording as approval. Keep its short exact original quote visible and immutable. Attribute the latest transition to email AI rather than falsely attributing it to the application owner.

Show one valid approval and zero active applications. Preserve the earlier correction history and the original starting snapshot. Provide evidence and snapshot navigation only, without a second application, remote submission claim, payment testing, or customer ownership. Keep the source quote, recipient, application identifier, and timestamps readable.

title: 申请结束后迟到邮件不重开记录
prompt:
Draw one standalone 1490 × 1056 static prototype using the supplied references and common style. Present a later independent branch of Alex Morgan C001, Northline LLC, and hello@northline.example. PayPal APP-002 was awaiting documents but has now been internally terminated. Stripe APP-001 remains a valid approval dated 10/12/2026, so Alex remains completed.

Design the saved application history, not another ending confirmation. Show the successful internal termination by 李敏 at 10/17/2026 16:00 PT, with a short reason that the team will not continue this attempt. A subsequent receipt entry at 16:20 records a delayed replay of E-102. Preserve its original received timestamp, 09:20, and its exact request for July through September statements. Label this event as recorded but not applied because the application is ended. The current status must still be terminated; the active slot is released and no replacement application has been created.

Separate original mail time, processing time, source, and human operator. Retain the old evidence and immutable starting snapshot. Provide read-only history navigation. Explain the distinction between ending an internal record and withdrawing a case at PayPal. Do not silently reopen the application, auto-start another attempt, delete evidence, or suggest the delayed message invalidates Stripe approval.

title: 撤销单项人工处理决定确认
prompt:
Draw one standalone 1490 × 1056 static prototype with a centered confirmation overlay and a recognizable but subordinate gateway requirement detail behind it. Use the supplied references and common style. This fictional independent branch occurs on 10/17/2026 at 10:10 PT, before any OUT-201 reply. Alex Morgan C001 remains completed through Stripe APP-001; PayPal APP-002 remains awaiting documents with application owner 李敏.

Confirm revocation of one incorrect manual handling decision on REQ-01, based on email E-102. At 10:00, 李敏 accidentally marked this requirement completed without sending the requested statements. Show that selected decision, its operator and time, then a clear before-and-after comparison: completed to pending. The exact requirement remains July through September statements; its text and original email are not being edited. Include a filled revocation reason and read-only current operator 李敏 at 10:10.

The confirmation has not been applied yet. Explain that only the selected processing mark will change; other requirements, application status, customer completion, immutable snapshot, and original mail remain unchanged. State that there is no sent-message evidence in this branch and that undo cannot retract actual email. Keep cancel and confirm actions distinct. Concurrent changes use the existing shared conflict treatment rather than introducing another override. Do not offer bulk undo, delete, reassignment, or external submission.
